The '''M3-M1 Medical Droid''' was a type of [[Medical droid/Legends|Medical droid]] that was used during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Despite being featured and named in a promotional screenshot for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]], the M3-M1 Medical Droid does not appear anywhere within the game itself; while the droid shares the same basic character model as other medical droids, no droids are named M3-M1 or M3-M1 Medical Droid, though it is possible it refers to the Class of the droids utilizing the M3-M1 appearance such as the case was for the [[GE3-series protocol droid]] in [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic|Knights of the Old Republic]].
